description: This file defines schemas and validation logic for report scheduling and notification configurations in the Superset project, including classes for report schedule creation, update, recipient configuration, and Slack channel schema.

classes.name: ValidatorConfigJSONSchema
classes.description: Schema for validation configuration of alert validators, including operation and threshold.

classes.name: ReportRecipientConfigJSONSchema
classes.description: Schema for recipient email configuration, including target, ccTarget, and bccTarget.

classes.name: ReportRecipientSchema
classes.description: Schema for report recipient, including type and recipient configuration.

classes.name: ReportSchedulePostSchema
classes.description: Schema for creating a new report schedule, including validation and custom width validation.

classes.name: ReportSchedulePutSchema
classes.description: Schema for updating an existing report schedule, with optional fields and validation.

classes.name: SlackChannelSchema
classes.description: Schema for Slack channel data, ignoring unknown fields.

methods.name: validate_crontab
methods.description: Validates if a CRON expression string is valid using croniter.
